_help: Games of the Week (games-of-the-week.html): 3 games per school week, picked from games already on the site to fit the month's unit. Keyed by month, then by in-month week (1, 2, ...) using the start-month rule in school-year.js (a week belongs to the month its Monday is in). Each pick is [game name, one-line reason]. Names must match a New Games, Warm Up Games or Big-Group Games card exactly; the build warns if one does not, or if a game repeats inside a month. Equipment and the link come from the game's card. Edit, then run: node tools/build.js

1: Say My Name Rock, Paper, Scissors
A quick way to learn everyone’s name in the first week.
Here, There, Everywhere
Teaches the stop and travel signals you will use all year.
Four Corners
A whole-class game where everyone stays in, good for setting gym routines.
2: A tag warm-up with rescues, so nobody sits out.
Partner passing and trapping, the first soccer skill of the unit.
Four nets keep a big class busy with lots of touches.
3: Pair Running
Builds steady running for the Terry Fox run on Friday.
Avoid the Mines
Everyone dribbles at once with their head up.
Pin Galore Soccer
Every pin is a goal, so passing and shooting pay off fast.
4: Kangaroos and Crocodiles
A reaction tag that gets legs ready for football.
Crab Football
A low-key first football game that builds core strength.
End Zone Ball
Get the ball to a teammate in the end zone: the big idea of football.
5: Dodging past defenders, like a ball carrier finding space.
Small-group keep-away for quick passes and getting open.
Steal the flags and bring them home: attack and defend at once.

1: Predators and Prey Tag
Fast chasing and dodging to start football class.
The Perfect Pass
Teams complete passes before scoring, so everyone touches the ball.
Football Frenzy
A busy whole-class game with foam footballs.
2: Running through zones past a tagger, like finding a gap.
Pass a foam football with no running, then shoot at the basket.
3: Jellyfish
A tag game where players help each other back in.
Catch & Step
Partner throwing and catching that gets harder as you succeed.
End Ball
Pass only, and score with a clean catch in the end zone.
4: Tic Tac Run
A react-and-chase warm-up with a coin-flip twist.
Punt to the line
Practise the drop-kick, the last football skill of the unit.
Elementary Ultimate Frisbee
Pass and move into space, the same idea as football.

1: Secret Agent Tag
A new tag game where nobody knows who the taggers are.
Hockey Dribbling Shapes
Everyone stick-handles at once, from simple to tricky.
Numbers Hockey
Short, safe floor hockey games with sticks kept low.
2: Tag where a throw and catch frees frozen players.
Dribble through gates and under hurdles for points.
A small-sided game that uses the hockey ideas of attack and defence.
3: Shadow Tag
A no-contact warm-up for quick changes of direction.
Zigzag & Shoot
Dribble around cones, then shoot at a target.
Star Wars
Teams aim at one big target ball, never at people.
4: Everybody’s It
Everyone tags and keeps playing, a busy warm-up.
Move Up Hockey
Each hit moves the target farther away: passing accuracy.
Bean Bag Battle
A team tossing battle to finish the hockey unit.

1: Alien Tag
A noodle tag warm-up with a quick jumping-jack return.
Hoop Hut Knock Down
Build a hut together, then knock it down with a soft ball.
Hidden Fleet
Lob soft balls over the net to find the hidden ships.
2: Partner throwing at cones: hit one and it becomes yours.
A big team game of chasing and collecting.

1: Waspital
Everybody-is-it tag with a stretch hospital to start the term.
Dribble the gates
Dribble through cone gates with finger pads and head up.
Captain Ball
Pass to your captain: the first basketball team game.
2: A roll of the die sends groups dribbling across the gym.
Chest passes off the wall in a quick relay.
Score while noodle taggers send you back.
3: Rob the Nest
Dribble to collect objects, one per trip.
Throw & Go
Pass, then move, so the next pass happens on the run.
Cornerball
Pass to a teammate in a corner hoop to score: getting open.
4: Team Tag
Pass the ball to get close enough to tag.
Side to Side
Partner passing with side jumps between hoops.
Bench Ball
Catch a pass on the bench to bring a teammate up.

1: Slippery Snakes
Jump or step over a wiggling rope: a gentle start to ropes.
Jump The River
Jump the gap between two ropes, and it widens after each success.
Rope Hoop Scoop
Partners use skipping ropes to carry a hoop home.
2: Travel to the music, then share a hoop. Nobody sits out.
Hop through the hoops on one foot with planned landings.
Teams stay linked as a snake and pass objects back to the tail.
3: Rush Hour
A traffic game for speed changes and safe spacing.
Helicopter Jump
Jump the sliding noodle and stick the landing.
Jump to Hoop Race
A jumping relay from hoop to hoop.
4: Mirror Mirror
Run to music, then freeze and copy a partner’s pose.
Jumping Jack Hoop Challenge
Spin a hoop, do jumping jacks, catch it, and add one.
Chicken Checkers
Leave your base on the call and claim a new one.

1: Balloon Keep-Up
Keep one balloon up as a team: the first step to volleying.
Card Pass Challenge
Bump in a circle and beat the number on your card.
NitroBall 2.0
Volleyball meets four square with a waist-high net.
2: Quick hands and ready position for volleyball.
A relay to set or volley balls into your team hoop.
Small-sided volleyball over a rope net.
3: Catch Clap
Eyes on the ball, the habit every volleyball hit needs.
Hand Tennis
Open-hand rallies over a line or bench.
FLY BACK
Throw and catch over the net, a stepping stone to volleyball.
4: Balloon Keep-Ups
An easy welcome back from Spring Break.
Wall Rally
Keep a rally going against the wall with one bounce.
Four Square Paddle Ball
Hoop courts and paddles for striking and rallies.

1: Animals
Animal moves warm up arms, legs and core for gymnastics.
Frogs on the Lily Pads
Two-foot jumps with a stuck landing.
Safe to Shore
Cross the floor using only the islands: balance and planning.
2: Everyone moves in crab walk: strong arms for gymnastics.
Walk the bench and move cones from side to side.
Co-operative challenges on mats, done as a team.
3: Daytime / Nighttime
Travel, then freeze in a strong, still shape.
Spot-Jump Path
Jump the targets with quiet, stuck landings.
Stick Tic-Tac-Toe
A stuck landing claims the hoop. Three in a row wins.
4: Bridges & Rivers
Half the class makes shapes while the others travel over and under.
Crawl and Roll Challenge
Link a crawl into a roll across the mats.
Wheelbarrow Walk Olympics
Partner strength walks to bronze, silver and gold cones.

1: Sneak & React
Quick starts, like the start of a sprint.
Long Jump Challenge
Beat the team mark from the same line.
Jungle Run Relays
A relay with a hoop, a jump and a cone.
2: Run on the call in a circle: quick reactions.
Timed two-foot jumps over a rolling ball.
Laps of the circle with clean hand-offs.
3: Colour Hunt
Run and collect the colour that is called.
Pace lap
Learn to pace a run so you reach the cone on time.
Balance Carry
Carry an object without dropping it: control while moving.
4: Catch Me If You Can (sprint)
Short sprints with a head start: speed practice.
Cone Relay
Remember the order, then sprint the cones.
Fetch Relay
One item per trip, then tag the next runner.
5: Grab-and-go sprints for Track and Field Day week.
A shuttle relay to sharpen starts and turns.
Run across and bring a teammate home.

1: Mat Tag
Run the bases and stay safe on the mats.
Overarm throw-and-catch
Practise the overarm throw to a partner.
Continuous Kick Ball
Kickball where several runners can be on base at once.
2: Chase a moving bucket to return balls: quick feet.
Throw tennis balls to knock volleyballs off cones.
Hit, run to the hoop, and fielders throw to the hoop.
3: Back to Base
Travel, then hurry back to your base on the whistle.
Bozo / bucket toss
Underhand tosses into buckets at longer distances.
Diamond Strike
All four hitters run a base on any hit.
4: Chuck the Chicken
A fun closer for the last class of the year.
Throw-Clap-Catch
Clap first, then catch: eyes on the ball.
Fun Kickball
Six-base kickball to finish the year.
